notes.title: Z-Collapse Release date!
notes.notes:
Hello dear zombie lovers!

An important news from our new game : [b]Z-Collapse[/b]. The grand strategy game that simulate a global zombie invasion.

Monthes of work have passed. I would like to thank all beta-testers that have proposed their help. The reviews were vastly positive. Thanks to them, bugs have been fixed, interesting new features have been implemented, and some other have also been added on the post-release list.

Wait... You said "release", right ? Oh yes I did. the Apocalypse has now a date. So make sure you a ready for this: [b]Z-Collapse[/b] will be released on Steam on the [b]01-September-2022[/b]!

Alongside that announcement, here is a brand new trailer :

[previewyoutube=l_ebSKoNyug;full][/previewyoutube]

Are you ready to lead your country through the Armageddon?

notes.title: New release 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello dear horde leaders !

Alongside with the Android tablets release, today is the release of the version 1.2. The main new feature is the seasons handling !

Now that you know how to exterminate all humans, let's make it more difficult... This new version includes the seasons. Which means that during summer, the humans will go out for holidays and parties: an ideal time to strike! But during winter, your zombies will freeze... which brings a lot of malus.

With this new functionnality, you will have to adapt your gamestyle: avoiding fights during winter, and killing as many humans as possible during summer.

Good luck, and happy slaughtering !

Changes list :
######V 1.2.0######
-Added seasons
-Corrected a bug in manpower earning during battles
-Various english texts corrections

notes.title: Version 1.1 release !
notes.notes:
Hello dear horde leaders !

It has been almost two weeks since the game release. And the first reviews were very promising. I would like to say a big thank you, to everyone !

As I am still working on the game to add new functionalities, today is the release of the version 1.1. The main new feature is the Vaccine research !

Do you remember the easy days, where you just add to slowly infest the whole United States ? Those days are gone ! Because the human will now try to find a cure for the disease. And if you don't eradicate them before, you won't be able to infest anyone anymore...

The vaccine will be created by the research centers. So you will have to destroy them to slow the cure breakthrough. But beware, the humans will rebuild the lost centers after some times...

Good luck, and happy slaughtering !

Changes list :
######V 1.1.0######
-Added vaccine research
-Research centers are now rebuilt by AI
-Remove button noise for recruiting troops
-Corrected a crash on refugees camp destruction
-Text corrections
-Space button is now pausing game
-New autosave system
